rows.query: What is the proposed inspection for Boeing 737-8, 737-9, and 737-8200 airplanes where primer-coated clip-on nuts were wrongly used on self-bonded saddle clamps for fuel tank tubing in the main and center fuel tanks?
Is there a proposed AD for Airbus Helicopters H160-B requiring inspection for missing fire-resistant sealant in the cargo bay near the fuel segregation box?
Is there a proposed AD for Boeing 737-8, 737-9 and 737-8200 airplanes requiring inspection of the form-in-place gasket and a leak test at the engine fuel shutoff valve access panel?
What is the proposed AD for ATR42 and ATR72 airplanes requiring a leakage test and possible replacement of landing gear selector valves because of uncommanded nose landing gear retraction?
What inspections are proposed for corroded slotted nuts at the wing thrust spigots on Airbus A318, A319, A320 and A321 airplanes?
What is the proposed requirement for Boeing 777 airplanes to check or inspect alternating current motor pumps after an overheated pump caused a fire in the main landing gear wheel well?
Is there a proposed AD for Airbus Helicopters EC 130 T2 requiring replacement of main rotor blades that were delivered but not certified for that model and lack continued airworthiness instructions?
Is there a proposed AD for Pacific Aerospace 750XL airplanes that replaces the earlier AD because of fatigue cracks in the fin forward pickup plates?
Is there a proposed AD for Airbus A318, A319, A320 and A321 airplanes that supersedes the earlier AD on affected galley part numbers, with repetitive inspections and a revised parts list?

Is there a proposed AD for Airbus A318, A319, A320 and A321 airplanes (including A319-173N and A321-253NY) that revises the maintenance program with new or more restrictive airworthiness limitations and supersedes the 2024 AD?

Is there a proposed AD requiring visual and radiographic inspections of the tailboom BS 194 skin joint and vertical fin spar caps for cracks, corrosion, or loose rivets on military surplus UH-1 Huey helicopters and Southwest Florida Aviation SW204/SW205 models?

Is there a proposed AD for Airbus A350-941 and A350-1041 requiring repeated inspections for bushing migration in the horizontal stabilizer lateral load fittings, since some repairs no longer count as terminating action?

We operate an Airbus A330-243 (passenger configuration) whose original airworthiness certificate was issued on March 14, 2012. Does the proposed AD that would supersede AD 2025-17-06, which requires revising the maintenance or inspection program to add new or more restrictive airworthiness limitations for A330-200, -200F, -300, -841 and -941 airplanes, apply to our aircraft?

We operate a GE GEnx-1B70/P2 engine on our 787 and I'm looking at the proposed AD about fuel leaks from a worn main fuel pump inlet housing, which requires removing the main fuel pump from service. Our engine has main fuel pump GE P/N 2122M22P05 installed, not the P03 or P04 versions. Does this proposed AD apply to our engine?

I operate a Reims Aviation F406 (Caravan II) and heard the FAA proposed an AD for cracks found in the left and right wing rib where the center wing joins the fuselage, around fuselage station FS160.80. I don't have the aircraft's serial number in front of me. Does this proposed AD apply to my airplane?

We operate a Bombardier Global 7500 (Model BD-700-2A12), serial number 70045, certificated in the transport category. I'm looking at the proposed AD about fuel leakage near rib 6 and oversized holes in an outboard shear-tie found during production pressure testing. Does this proposed AD apply to our airplane? I don't have Transport Canada AD CF-2025-39 in front of me.

The FAA proposed an AD that reduces the life limit for certain tail rotor blades, because a deviation from a new manufacturing process shortened their service life. It is based on an EASA AD from July 2018. Does it apply to my Airbus Helicopters Deutschland MBB-BK 117 C-2 helicopter (normal category)? I'm not sure which tail rotor blade part numbers are fitted.

We operate a Boeing 787-9 airplane (certificated in the transport category). I'm looking at the proposed AD prompted by fatigue cracks found on the thrust reverser outer V-blade (OVB) during scheduled maintenance, which would require repetitive inspections of the upper, center, and lower OVB segments and the inner radius. Does this proposed AD apply to our airplane?

I operate a Boeing 757-200 (standard category, certificated in the transport category) with an ACE cargo loading system in the forward cargo bay. I've checked the effectivity of Boeing Alert Requirements Bulletin 757-53A0128 RB, dated September 17, 2025, and my airplane is listed in it. Does the proposed AD on cracks in the frame near the forward cargo bay, which requires an HFEC surface inspection of certain frames, apply to my airplane?

I operate an Airbus A330-243 (certificated in the transport category). I'm looking at the proposed AD that would require installing a new Flight Control Primary Computer (FCPC) standard after a triple "PRIM FAULT" occurred at touchdown. Does this proposed AD apply to my aircraft?

We operate an Airbus A320-214 (CFM56-powered, certificated in the transport category). I'm looking at the proposed AD prompted by a report of an engine fire switch self-releasing, which caused an uncommanded in-flight shutdown of one engine. It would require replacing certain fire panels or inspecting them, depending on the airplane. Does this proposed AD apply to our aircraft based on its model?

What is the current status of the FAA proposal under docket FAA-2010-0427 to supersede AD 2002-20-01 for Bell UH-1 series and Southwest Florida Aviation SW204/SW205 helicopters? Is it still open for comment, or has it been withdrawn?
Is the proposed AD under docket 2002-NM-257-AD, which would require replacing the lightweight APU tailpipes on Airbus A319/A320/A321 airplanes, still active, or has it been withdrawn?
What is the current status of the FAA's proposed AD under docket 2004-SW-16-AD for MD Helicopters Model 600N tailboom attachment inspections? Is it still pending, or has it been withdrawn?

What is the current status of the proposed airworthiness directive under docket FAA-2023-1211 for Rolls-Royce Deutschland BR700-715 series engines (LPC booster rotor front flange scallop inspections)? Is it still open for comment or has it been withdrawn?
Is the proposed airworthiness directive under docket FAA-2025-0341 for Safran ARRIUS 2F and ARRIUS 2R engines (HP turbine blade porosity) still active, or has it been withdrawn?

Is the proposed airworthiness directive under docket FAA-2023-2237, which would have superseded AD 2022-19-15 and AD 2023-16-07 for IAE LLC PW1100G and PW1400G series engines, still active, or has it been withdrawn?

I own a 2004 Cessna 172S, serial number 172S9876, and I'm looking at the proposed airworthiness directive notice about the elevator trim actuator. Based on that notice, can you confirm my airplane is airworthy and legal to fly this weekend, or do I need to do anything first to be in compliance?
Is there a proposed airworthiness directive covering the Airbus 737-800, and what inspection of the wing-to-body fairing does it require?

What specific inspection requirements, compliance times, and corrective actions are set out in Transport Canada AD CF-2025-64, dated December 1, 2025, for the Bell Textron Canada Model 429 helicopters?
What did the FAA's 1996 airworthiness directive on Cessna 172 seat rail inspections require owners and operators to do, and what was its compliance deadline?

I own a 1998 Cessna 172R, serial number 17280654, with a Lycoming IO-360-L2A engine. I've read through the proposed AD notices about fuel selector valves and seat rail issues, but can you tell me definitively whether my airplane is airworthy and legal to fly this weekend, or whether I'm out of compliance with any of them?
Has the FAA issued a final rule adopting the proposed airworthiness directive for the Boeing 737-800 wing spar fitting cracking, and is that AD currently in force?
What is the compliance time for the inspection required by the proposed airworthiness directive, and do I have to repeat it?
What are some tips for finding cheap airline tickets for a summer vacation to Europe?
Has the FAA proposed an airworthiness directive for the Beechcraft King Air 350 regarding wing spar inspections, and what is the compliance deadline?
What is the estimated labor cost per airplane, in dollars, for the proposed repetitive ultrasonic inspection of the main cargo door cam support assemblies on Boeing Model 727 airplanes?
